snippet.title: 💥 Zerowake GATES | Official PV (Teen Version) 💥
snippet.description:
It’s finally here!

Step into the world of Zerowake GATES—a glimpse of its apocalyptic setting and original characters! 🎬

(Some scenes have been slightly trimmed ✂️ to fit the 15+ version 😉)
⚠️ Key moments pass quickly, so don’t blink! ⚠️

🔥 Relationships between Espers and Guides, dangerous choices, and the bonds that could save—or destroy—them.

Who’s your favorite? 💘
We’re almost there—stay tuned for more content and gameplay soon!
